_comment: MG-23 blocker 1 fixture — MUST FAIL (nonzero). resource_changes is an OBJECT map rather than an array. This already exited nonzero before the fix, but only INCIDENTALLY: the failure surfaced two sections later as 'failed to collect the resource universe', a jq error whose message points at the collector rather than at the malformed input. The TYPE validation now rejects it up front with a message naming the offending key and its actual type. Same exit code, an operator-legible reason — and, more importantly, the rejection is now INTENTIONAL rather than a side effect of a jq filter that a future refactor could silently make error-tolerant.
